name: South East Water WRMP24
fact: South East Water publishes WRMP24 technical overview, preferred plan, headroom, supply-demand and monitoring documents.
gate: Use exact resource-zone/headroom evidence; company-wide plan is insufficient for parcel scoring.

name: South East Water Future Water
fact: South East Water's Future Water page publishes its WRMP24 and strategic supply options including desalination concepts.
gate: Options are strategic and not proof of delivery or development capacity.

name: United Utilities final WRMP24 main report
fact: United Utilities' official final WRMP24 main report is dated December 2024.
gate: Use current resource-zone tables and network evidence before any site-level conclusion.

name: United Utilities WRMP24 supply forecast
fact: The official supply-forecast report distinguishes Strategic, Carlisle, North Eden and Barepot resource zones and planning scenarios.
gate: Zone supply forecasts are not local distribution-network connection confirmations.

name: UK Power Networks Open Data Portal
fact: UKPN's public page says the portal exposes network asset, capacity and usage datasets; catalogue browsing is public while full table access may require free registration.
gate: Do not create an account or infer unavailable table values; catalogue presence alone is not capacity evidence.

name: UKPN pre-application support
fact: UKPN points prospective connections to pre-application advice, cable plans, its open-data portal and Appendix G/GSP capacity context.
gate: Pre-application information is advisory and not a connection offer.

name: UKPN DSO data roadmap
fact: UKPN DSO describes NDP, LTDS, historical and real-time GSP power-flow datasets and their update cycles.
gate: Headroom and power-flow data inform screening but do not replace a formal connection study.

name: UKPN DSO operational data page
fact: UKPN's NODD combines GSP limits, queue information and power flows; Real-Time Constraint Metering reports near-real-time constraint headroom.
gate: Operational network signals can change quickly and are not a contractual connection position.

name: UKPN DSO expanded-data page
fact: UKPN documents expanded NODD granularity toward grid, circuit and transformer-level power-flow information.
gate: Granular data remains screening evidence until a formal connection study.

name: UKPN DSO data-about page
fact: UKPN says its DSO data team publishes regularly updated capacity, usage and infrastructure datasets and tools including Connections Lab.
gate: Tool/data availability is not a site connection offer.

name: UKPN connections reform
fact: UKPN's current connections-reform page directs applicants to operational data on GSPs and substations before application.
gate: Reform/process context does not establish an individual project's queue position or energisation date.

name: UKPN capacity visibility portal announcement
fact: UKPN describes publication of GSP spare-capacity and queue information to improve siting decisions.
gate: Published capacity/queue information is dynamic and must be verified for the exact application date.

name: NGED network capacity map
fact: NGED says its map indicates likely connection headroom and explicitly does not replace a formal application; full map access requires free registration.
gate: No account is created; public methodology only is used and no hidden map values are inferred.

name: NGED Network Opportunity Map
fact: NGED's Network Opportunity Map provides indicative demand/generation opportunities across BSP, primary and distribution substations and replaces older capacity maps.
gate: Colour/headroom indications remain non-binding; no account-gated values are used.

name: NGED connected-data network capacity dataset
fact: NGED's data catalogue describes demand/generation headroom and key asset ratings while warning data may be inaccurate, omitted or out of date.
gate: Independent verification and formal application remain required.

name: NGED DFES interactive map
fact: NGED's DFES map provides scenario projections at Electricity Supply Area or local-authority level within its licence area.
gate: Scenario projections are not current connection headroom or parcel-level capacity.

name: SSEN Generation Availability and Network Capacity
fact: SSEN publishes indicative large-development capacity information plus GSP/substation ratings, fault levels and contracted/quoted generation data.
gate: The map is indicative and must not be treated as a formal connection offer.

name: SSEN network-capacity collection
fact: SSEN's collection groups network capacity, embedded capacity, NDP and usage datasets.
gate: Collection discovery is not exact capacity confirmation.

name: SSEN Distribution data portal
fact: SSEN's current data portal exposes network-capacity and network-development assets and reports ongoing dataset publication activity in July 2026.
gate: Portal freshness does not make all underlying datasets live or binding.

name: SSEN low-carbon technology connections
fact: SSEN publishes primary-substation aggregates for connected EV chargers, heat pumps, solar and battery storage, dated 13 January 2026.
gate: Existing LCT connection totals do not equal spare capacity for a new development.

name: SP Electricity North West data portal
fact: SP Electricity North West publishes network, connection, forecasting and operational data and points applicants to capacity heat maps before connection applications.
gate: Heat maps support screening only; a formal connection application is still required.

name: SP Electricity North West NDP methodology 2026
fact: The May 2026 NDP methodology identifies capacity heatmaps, NDP headroom, LTDS and DFES as network-planning evidence with different time horizons.
gate: Planning/headroom datasets are not contractual capacity reservations.

name: SP Electricity North West operational decision framework
fact: The framework describes open data including primary/BSP demand and generation headroom, DFES and flexibility information.
gate: Operational/planning datasets support assessment but do not replace a formal connection offer.

name: Planning Data nutrient-neutrality catchment dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 39 Natural England nutrient-neutrality catchments; collector last ran 22 July 2026, while the platform notes some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Use authoritative entity geometry and current Natural England/LPA advice before applying a nutrient constraint.

name: Teesmouth and Cleveland Coast nutrient catchment
fact: Natural England authoritative entity 590012 provides the Teesmouth and Cleveland Coast SPA/Ramsar nutrient-neutrality catchment geometry.
gate: Exact canonical parcel intersection and current nutrient rules remain required.

name: River Camel nutrient catchment
fact: Natural England authoritative River Camel SAC nutrient-neutrality catchment geometry is published with an amended-catchment note.
gate: Exact parcel intersection and current mitigation requirements remain required.

name: River Itchen nutrient catchment
fact: Natural England authoritative River Itchen SAC nutrient-neutrality catchment geometry is published by Planning Data.
gate: Exact parcel intersection and current nutrient guidance remain required.

name: Groundwater source-protection-zone consideration screen
fact: Planning Data's design service is still screening the groundwater source-protection-zone consideration and whether a data standard/source is ready.
gate: Design-stage research is not authoritative constraint geometry and cannot be used for parcel scoring.
